messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGERDUTY — SEV1: Detected cross-region failover oscillation. automated traffic-shift engaged for us-east-1 -> ap-northeast-1 due to elevated ELB 5xx from us-east-1c, but healthchecks flapping in ap-northeast-1 triggered rollback. Please acknowledge in #incidents and follow runbook.
Aria SRE: ack. seeing rapid error spikes and two automated shifts in the last 7 minutes. p95 jumped to 2.2s during oscillation. some customers saw session reconnects.
Nadia (oncall): oncall here. @Tom (netops) any cloud AZ notices? could be provider or our routing.
Tom (netops): provider status quiet. BGP stream shows withdraws for a handful of /24s in us-east-1c during the window. Also seeing ICMP fragmentation and MSS clamping behavior on transit. suspect packet-loss-induced healthcheck failures.
Reed (prodops): automation details: traffic-shift policy triggered at 04:10UTC to ap-northeast-1. at 04:13UTC healthchecks in ap-northeast-1 failed (many 503s from cold backends) so automation rolled back to us-east-1 which re-triggered failures -> thrash. That explains oscillation.
Aria SRE: impact: Hosted API error-rate peaked at ~12% during thrash window (04:10-04:18UTC). Dedicated clusters in us-east-1c experienced connection resets and reduced throughput. CS please notify affected customers.
CustomerSuccess: starting outreach. collecting tenant ids and affected endpoints. drafting interim update.
Nadia (oncall): proposed mitigation: 1) disable automation to stop oscillation 2) isolate us-east-1c AZ (cordon + drain) 3) pre-warm ap-northeast-1 backends before shifting more traffic 4) open provider ticket for packet loss/MTU. Who can disable automation?
Reed (prodops): disabling auto-shift now: `POST https://int-api.redwood.local/v1/ops/traffic-shift/auto_disable` -> 200 OK. Automation paused.
Tom (netops): opened provider ticket #PR-77654. Provider confirms they see intermittent transit packet drops affecting us-east-1c peering. They've engaged partner and propose route flap mitigation at their edge. ETA ~30-50m.
Aria SRE: starting drain for us-east-1c: `kubectl cordon -l az=us-east-1c -n model-serving && kubectl drain -l az=us-east-1c --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`. drain in progress: 14 nodes cordoned, 11 pods evicted, 3 pods blocked due to PV detach latency.
Reed (prodops): pre-warming ap-northeast-1 model caches to avoid cold-start 503s: `./ops/prewarm --region ap-northeast-1 --concurrency 200 --prompts-file top_5k_prompts.txt`. kicked off.
Nadia (oncall): also adding temporary proxy overlay to override DNS for control-plane VIPs to point at healthy endpoints in us-east-1a/us-east-1b until provider confirms fix.
Tom (netops): adding BGP community to prefer alternate transit for our prefixes to avoid the flaky path: `bgpctl set-community 65010:400 prefer-alternate` applied to affected prefixes.
Aria SRE: monitoring: after overrides and pre-warm, error-rate trending down. but still seeing elevated p95 (~350ms above baseline) as caches warm.
CustomerSuccess: interim update sent at 04:28UTC with ETA note and a brief impact summary. adding affected orgs list.
IncidentBot: Reminder — set incident severity and postmortem owner. Suggested severity: P1.
Nadia (oncall): assigning postmortem to @Aria SRE. Aria please take timeline and follow-ups.
Aria SRE: will do. immediate artifacts to capture: BGP stream, NAT GW ICMP/MMTU logs, ELB healthcheck traces, traffic-shift decision logs, prewarm job logs, and provider ticket transcript.
Reed (prodops): once drain completes we'll slowly reintroduce capacity and run canary ramp to ap-northeast-1 with strong prewarming: +10% every 3m, require success >=99.5% and p95 within +200ms.
Tom (netops): provider reports initial edge mitigation applied at 04:45UTC. ICMP bursts and withdraws reduced. Monitoring shows BGP stability improving.
Aria SRE: starting controlled canary of ap-northeast-1: canary 10% -> success 99.7% success and p95 within threshold. ramping to 30% over next 6 minutes.
Nadia (oncall): handoff planned at 05:00UTC to night oncall @Reed (prodops). Handoff notes: automation paused, us-east-1c cordoned, provider mitigation in flight, postmortem owner @Aria SRE. escalate to netops if BGP withdraws reappear.
Reed (prodops): ack taking handoff. will keep watch on alerts and ensure automation remains disabled until PM/infra signoff.
Leah PM: product note — please include brief note on any feature inconsistencies caused by cold caches and session disconnects for comms to Sales.
Aria SRE: adding action items: (1) add a hysteresis/gating to traffic-shift automation to avoid immediate rollback on short-lived candidate failures, (2) add MTU/ICMP fragmentation detection into network probes, (3) require prewarm success metrics before shifting nontrivial traffic, (4) improve on-call runbook to include provider-edge cache checks.
CustomerSuccess: preparing customer post-incident template. will coordinate with Aria for timelines.
IncidentBot: On-call handoff scheduled at 05:00UTC. Please close after 1h of stability.
Aria SRE: marking status mitigated -> monitoring. will compile initial postmortem draft and link it in thread when ready. If anything changes @Reed will update. :white_check_mark:
